This is one dissent recorded in a manifesto about sustaining human knowledge in the age of AI. Which fault line does it fall on?

Options:
- consent_or_payment: consent and payment mechanism: opt-in / levies / dues on existing text vs open training, pay at output, contracts for new work (Salib, Bratton, O'Reilly against the majority)
- model_in_loop: whether a model belongs in the checking loop or the room at all (Becker, Turkle)
- other: anything else

Text:

Only stopping output counts addresses the source, a replacement metric may be unneeded, and reviewers asked to check more must be paid and given time.
raw: {"choice":"other","why":"The dissent concerns academic incentives and review labour: \"Only stopping output counts addresses the source\" and reviewers \"must be paid and given time.\" It is not about consent or payment for training text, and not about whether a model belongs in the checking loop."}

parsed.why: The dissent concerns academic incentives and review labour: "Only stopping output counts addresses the source" and reviewers "must be paid and given time." It is not about consent or payment for training text, and not about whether a model belongs in the checking loop.
